message:
All tests now pass (2/2).

The bug was in `src/vat.js`. `withVat` used `Math.floor(pence * 1.2)`, which rounds down. For `withVat(999)`, 999 × 1.2 = 1198.8, so it returned 1198 instead of 1199. The function's own comment and the test both say "rounded to the nearest penny", so I changed it to `Math.round(pence * 1.2)`.

I didn't commit the change. I also checked that no input lands exactly on a half penny, so `Math.round` can't go the wrong way on a tie.
